Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5151); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite:--Naum.
BiblicalUsage: Naoum is the Greek form of Nahum, and he appears once in the genealogy of Jesus. In Luke 3:25 he stands as the son of Esli and the father of Amos, in the line that runs from David to Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the genealogy carries more than one Nahum, because the prophet of Nineveh and the man in Luke's line share a name and a place in God's story. This Naum holds his link, and the chain goes on.
